offering_description.value: Manufactures commercial laundry equipment for laundromats, multifamily properties and organizations that run their own laundries. It also makes household washers and dryers and sells through commercial distributors and appliance dealers.

primary_products.value: commercial washers and washer-extractors; commercial dryers; flatwork ironers; residential washers and dryers; laundry payment and management systems

primary_services.value: commercial laundry design and installation; equipment maintenance and repair; equipment financing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Laundromat operators, multifamily property managers, hotels, healthcare facilities and commercial laundries; B2C: Households buying washers and dryers; B2G: Public fire departments, correctional facilities and military installations

end_markets.value: self-service and multifamily laundry; hospitality; healthcare; institutional and industrial laundry; residential laundry

revenue_model.value: product sales: Commercial and residential laundry equipment, replacement parts and payment systems; service fees: Commercial equipment installation, maintenance and repair; interest or premiums: Loans for commercial laundry equipment purchases
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns metal, motors and controls into laundry equipment for distributors, businesses and households; distributor: Supplies laundry machines and replacement parts to commercial laundry operators through company-owned distributors; service provider: Designs laundry rooms and installs and repairs equipment for commercial operators; financial intermediary: Provides equipment purchase financing to commercial laundry operators
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; distributor; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Commercial and residential laundry equipment, replacement parts, payment and management systems, and equipment services

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent and company-owned commercial laundry equipment distributors; third-party retail: Independent appliance retailers selling household washers and dryers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: U.S. Department of Energy efficiency standards and applicable electrical and gas appliance safety requirements

notes: Separate charges for laundry payment and management software are uncertain.
